options.C: I recommend implementing version control within the application layer. For our Java/Spring Boot-centric technology stack, this approach is the least intrusive and easiest to maintain. options.D: My proposal will closely follow the "multiple service replicas, domain isolation" strategy approved by Boss Li at the architecture review meeting. Specifically for Kubernetes implementation, we can write separate Dockerfiles and Deployment configuration files for v1 and v2 versions of the service. The key is to configure the cluster's ingress traffic, which is the Ingress resource. We can define two host-based routing rules in the Ingress's `spec.rules`: direct all traffic accessing `api.v1.xxx.com` to the backend v1 Service, and direct traffic accessing `api.v2.xxx.com` to the v2 Service.
